snippet.title: Deck & Defense - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo out now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479370/Deck__Defense/

A real-time deckbuilder roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.
